instruction.source: 用户已确认的验收范围
instruction.text:
每视频建主机型，只对齐该机型出现的镜头
微波炉结构、可见机械动作和镜头视角

provenance.dimension_basis: Manufacturer nominal envelope/cavity dimensions; camera proportions and all unmeasured local details reconstructed from this video.
provenance.hidden_structure: Sheet thicknesses, hinge bushings, rear internals, latch engagement and wiring not measured; inferred engineering completions, not manufacturing drawings.

review.review_method: Actual encoded input.mp4 and output.mp4 were decoded into paired start/middle/end boards for every retained shot and visually inspected. Native closed/open model renders and source-specific action boards were also inspected.

projection_cache_validation.basis: Native render of a sufficiently wide camera frustum. Output affine sampling is numerically equivalent to animated camera focal length and optical shift for unchanged camera extrinsics and mechanical state. A separate native render is made for each changed mechanical/display state.

checks.source_frame_order_and_rate: verified exact retained frame order and original rational frame rate
checks.geometry: source-specific silhouette, visible controls, handle and hinge family reviewed
checks.door_and_controls: visible door states and observed action timings reviewed; hidden middle angles inferred
checks.stage: same frozen Tangyuan scene and lighting
checks.rendering: actual native geometry rendered; source pixels absent from generated video
checks.camera: shot-specific calibrated framing plus dense source-feature image pan/zoom; approximate extrinsic camera pose

limitations: No claim of pixel-perfect source camera reconstruction; focal depth, hidden geometry and local dimensions are inferred.
People, food, editorial arrows, graphic insets, overlays and original background are outside the asset scope.
Static source infographic photos remain mechanically static; camera pan/zoom follows retained source frame tracking.
Projection-cache numerical equivalence validates the native resampling method, not source-camera calibration accuracy.

user_prompt.latest: d盘download文件夹中还有部分微波炉视频 继续生成
retained_requirements: 每个视频建模一个；微波炉结构、可见机械动作和镜头视角逐帧对齐。
每视频建主机型，只对齐该机型出现的镜头。
固定Tangyuan场景打光，视觉风格与红色微波炉一致。
一个资产只有一页，上方input/output，下方详细过程。
修改提示词要保存；网站仅压缩图片/视频，不上传原生资产；直接Git到远端。
面板与门齐平，主体和门圆角，黑色控制面板内凹，腔体与主体无明显缝隙。

assistant_revision.origin: assistant-authored reconstruction and review notes, not additional user instructions
assistant_revision.geometry: 独立按该源主机型构建。官方包络/腔体尺寸，视频重建圆角门框、把手、通风、控制布局；所有隐藏机构为推断。
iterations: v001初建原生分件与固定场景渲染
v003黑色控制区和NE品牌区分离
Sharp控制面板宽度、LCD和按键位置按完整产品帧修正
新增真实凹槽钢边框，门和钢面板齐平
解析平面检查后后移腔口翻边，消除关门时金属重叠
assistant_revision.animation: 原始帧号逐帧保存；剪辑段保持原始顺序和帧率；静态机械状态使用等价视锥采样，机械状态变化逐状态原生渲染；显示数字为分段几何。
assistant_revision.camera: 逐帧静态机身特征跟踪缩放和平移；每镜头用可见部件标定视角/画面位置。宏观相机深度和焦距是近似。
assistant_revision.encoded_review: Actual encoded input.mp4 and output.mp4 were decoded into paired start/middle/end boards for every retained shot and visually inspected. Native closed/open model renders and source-specific action boards were also inspected.
assistant_revision.final_camera_motion_corrections: Dense source action observations corrected door start/end states and edit cuts. Recessed controls, cavity-mouth clearances, Sharp guide labels, close-up framing and visibility corrected during actual encoded comparison.

source_specific_revision.revision: Source-specific native reconstruction and paired encoded-media review completed; exact retained frame indexing with approximate source camera calibration.
limitations: 食物、人物、广告文字和圆形次要插图不属于重建资产。
摄像机隐藏焦距、深度和局部尺寸为近似，非标定实测逐像素复刻。
手部遮挡的中间门角由可见端点插值；旋钮不可辨认刻度仅近似。
底部结构、内部铰链、锁舌和未见背面为工程推断。
